(C) As used in this section, "accelerant" has the same meaning as in section 2929.01 of the Revised Code.

(D) The provisions of this section and of division (D)(2) of section 2903.11 , division (F)(20) of section 2929.13 , and d ivisions (B)(9) and (C)(6) of section 2929.14 of the Revised Code shall be known as "Judy's Law."
